events.txt: 🌍 Four humans wake in an untouched world: Eira, Ask, Embla, Torv. They know nothing — but they can observe everything. What will they create?
👁️ Eira noticed that grass fibers hold when twisted. An idea begins to form.
❄️ The first winter has come. The world turns white and hard, and the nights grow long. Fire is no longer comfort — it is life.
🪢 Eira twisted grass fibers into something strong — Eira's twine (Rope) has been invented! Makes it possible to bind parts together.
Eira tried something with stone — and failed. But failure teaches.
🔪 Eira struck two stones together and kept the sharp shard — Eira's knife (Sharpened stone) has been invented! Faster gathering of everything.
🌿 Eira began carving a sign into a flat stone when something new is made — no one told them to. Others may follow. (Carving a sign into a flat stone)

✨ From that day on, Eira was known as Eira the Spearmaker.

👁️ Torv noticed that grass fibers hold when twisted. An idea begins to form.
🔥 Eira rubbed sticks together until a spark caught the tinder — Eira's blaze (Fire) has been invented! Warmth at night. Opens the path to pottery and smithing.
🛞 Eira watched a log roll and understood something great — Eira's pulley (The Wheel) has been invented! The foundation of mills, carts — and everything that spins.
🏹 Eira bent a young branch with a cord and felt it fight back — Eira's birchbow (Bow) has been invented! The hunt no longer needs closeness. Deer fall at a distance.
🛖 Eira raised logs against each other into a shelter — Eira's home (Hut) has been invented! Shelter and warmth at night. Three huts close together become a village.
🌾 Eira let the wheel drive stones that ground grain — Eira's crusher (Mill) has been invented! The village can process food — famine recedes.

🧱 Torv built a stone chamber that gathered the heat of the fire — Torv's burnoven (Kiln) has been invented! Heat enough to melt what hides in ore and sand.
🌱 Torv pressed spilled seeds into turned soil and waited — Torv's tilling (Farming) has been invented! Food that returns every year. The village roots itself.
